interface.longDescription: The full-stack GoHighLevel (GHL) MCP for agency owners and funnel builders. Automate funnel and website layouts, CSS, and copy while keeping native 2-step carts, order bumps, and 1-click upsells intact. Batch-sync Custom Values and scan templates for broken merge tags, manage SaaS Mode rebilling, configure Brand Boards and Chat Widgets, provision users with least-privilege role presets, audit LC Phone numbers for wallet drain, onboard client domains with DNS and SSL verification, deploy 1-command spam-shield IVRs, and diff live sub-accounts against Master Snapshots.
defaultPrompt: Diff our live client sub-account against our Master Snapshot, sync Custom Values, and validate that no broken merge tags or TBD placeholders remain.
Export our main funnel checkout page layout, update the headline and CSS, and publish while preserving the 2-step cart and 1-click upsell.
Audit our sub-account LC Phone numbers for unassigned wallet drain, verify our branded-link CNAME, and deploy LeadShield contact form spam blocking + a call-screening IVR.
